name: report_code_bug

input.test: REQ-002 AC4: Any later bid is accepted only if it is at least 1 unit of the item currency higher than the current highest bid, otherwise it is rejected.
input.explanation: After a first bid of 100 was accepted, a second bid of 100 (not at least 1 higher) resolved instead of rejecting. The test is consistent with the criterion, so the minimum bid check is wrong. Possible causes: the highest bid is not updated on the item after the first bid, or the comparison allows equal amounts.
input.proposedFix: In BidService.placeBid, once an item has a highest bid, reject any amount below highestBidAmount + 1. Make sure an accepted bid sets item.highestBidAmount and highestBidderId and the item is saved with saveItem.

text:
The one failing test, REQ-002 AC4 in `test/UC-003.test.ts`, is a code bug. I left the test unchanged and reported it. I did not run `typecheck` or `run_tests`, because I changed no files.

The test places a bid of 100 and then a second bid of 100. The criterion says a later bid must be at least 1 unit higher than the current highest bid, so the second bid should be rejected. It was accepted. The test matches the criterion, so the bid check in `BidService.placeBid` is wrong.

My proposed fix is that `placeBid` should reject any amount below the highest bid plus 1. An accepted bid should also update the item's highest bid and bidder and save the item. I could not see the implementation, so I can't say which of those is the actual cause.
